content: Claude Code headless docs: --output-format json with --json-schema puts output in structured_output; result envelope (SDKResultMessage) has type, subtype (success|error_max_turns|error_during_execution|error_max_budget_usd|error_max_structured_output_retries), is_error, num_turns, result, total_cost_usd (client-side estimate), usage {input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens}, modelUsage (camelCase), permission_denials, many optional fields added often. Without --bare, -p runs project hooks and .mcp.json servers in cwd even untrusted; --bare requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (no OAuth). Piped stdin capped at 10MB.
